verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֖ח הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיַּאַסְפ֣וּ אֵלָ֔יו כָּל־ זִקְנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ham·me·leḵ way·ya·’as·p̄ū ’ê·lāw kāl- ziq·nê yə·hū·ḏāh wî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Then the king summoned . . . . . . all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO o rei ordenou, e todos os anciãos de Judá e de Jerusalém se reuniram a ele.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַל הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ בֵּית־ יְהוָ֡ה וְכָל־ אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָה֩ וְכָל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֨י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם אִתּ֗וֹ וְהַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ וְהַנְּבִיאִ֔ים וְכָל־ הָעָ֖ם לְמִקָּטֹ֣ן וְעַד־ גָּד֑וֹל וַיִּקְרָ֣א בְאָזְנֵיהֶ֗ם אֶת־ כָּל־ דִּבְרֵי֙ סֵ֣פֶר הַבְּרִ֔ית הַנִּמְצָ֖א בְּבֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al ham·me·leḵ bêṯ- Yah·weh wə·ḵāl ’îš yə·hū·ḏāh wə·ḵāl yō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim ’it·tōw wə·hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·han·nə·ḇî·’îm wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām lə·miq·qā·ṭōn wə·‘aḏ- gā·ḏō·wl way·yiq·rā ḇə·’ā·zə·nê·hem ’eṯ- kāl- diḇ·rê sê·p̄er hab·bə·rîṯ han·nim·ṣā bə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: And he went up to the house of the LORD with all the people of Judah and Jerusalem as well as the priests and the prophets all the people small and great and in their hearing he read all the words of the Book of the Covenant that had been found in the house of the LORD
verses.literalPt: O rei subiu à casa do SENHOR, e com ele todos os homens de Judá, e todos os moradores de Jerusalém, os sacerdotes, os profetas e todo o povo, desde o menor até ao maior; e leu aos ouvidos deles todas as palavras do livro da aliança, que se achou na casa do SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמֹ֣ד הַ֠מֶּלֶךְ עַֽל־ הָ֨עַמּ֜וּד וַיִּכְרֹ֥ת אֶֽת־ הַבְּרִ֣ית׀ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה לָלֶ֜כֶת אַחַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ וְלִשְׁמֹ֨ר מִצְוֺתָ֜יו וְאֶת־ עֵדְוֺתָ֤יו וְאֶת־ חֻקֹּתָיו֙ בְּכָל־ לֵ֣ב וּבְכָל־ נֶ֔פֶשׁ לְהָקִ֗ים אֶת־ דִּבְרֵי֙ הַבְּרִ֣ית הַזֹּ֔את הַכְּתֻבִ֖ים עַל־ הַסֵּ֣פֶר הַזֶּ֑ה וַיַּעֲמֹ֥ד כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם בַּבְּרִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ ham·me·leḵ ‘al- hā·‘am·mūḏ way·yiḵ·rōṯ ’eṯ- hab·bə·rîṯ lip̄·nê Yah·weh lā·le·ḵeṯ ’a·ḥar Yah·weh wə·liš·mōr miṣ·wō·ṯāw wə·’eṯ- ‘ê·ḏə·wō·ṯāw wə·’eṯ- ḥuq·qō·ṯāw bə·ḵāl lêḇ ū·ḇə·ḵāl ne·p̄eš lə·hā·qîm ’eṯ- diḇ·rê hab·bə·rîṯ haz·zōṯ hak·kə·ṯu·ḇîm ‘al- has·sê·p̄er haz·zeh way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ kāl- hā·‘ām bab·bə·rîṯ
verses.literal: So the king stood by the pillar and made a covenant before the LORD to follow . . . the LORD and to keep His commandments decrees and statutes with all his heart and all his soul and to carry out the words of the covenant that were written in this book And all the people entered into the covenant
verses.literalPt: E o rei se pôs em pé junto à coluna, e fez a aliança perante o SENHOR, para seguirem o SENHOR, e guardarem os seus mandamentos, os seus testemunhos e os seus estatutos, com todo o coração e com toda a alma, confirmando as palavras desta aliança, que estavam escritas naquele livro; e todo o povo apoiou esta aliança.

verses.original: וַיְצַ֣ו הַמֶּ֡לֶךְ אֶת־ חִלְקִיָּהוּ֩ הַכֹּהֵ֨ן הַגָּד֜וֹל וְאֶת־ כֹּהֲנֵ֣י הַמִּשְׁנֶה֮ וְאֶת־ שֹׁמְרֵ֣י הַסַּף֒ לְהוֹצִיא֙ מֵהֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה אֵ֣ת כָּל־ הַכֵּלִ֗ים הָֽעֲשׂוּיִם֙ לַבַּ֣עַל וְלָֽאֲשֵׁרָ֔ה וּלְכֹ֖ל צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וַֽיִּשְׂרְפֵ֞ם מִח֤וּץ לִירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ בְּשַׁדְמ֣וֹת קִדְר֔וֹן וְנָשָׂ֥א אֶת־ עֲפָרָ֖ם בֵּֽית־ אֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw ham·me·leḵ ’eṯ- ḥil·qî·yā·hū hak·kō·hên hag·gā·ḏō·wl wə·’eṯ- kō·hă·nê ham·miš·neh wə·’eṯ- šō·mə·rê has·sap̄ lə·hō·w·ṣî mê·hê·ḵal Yah·weh ’êṯ kāl- hak·kê·lîm hā·‘ă·śū·yim lab·ba·‘al wə·lā·’ă·šê·rāh ū·lə·ḵōl ṣə·ḇā haš·šā·mā·yim way·yiś·rə·p̄êm mi·ḥūṣ lî·rū·šā·lim bə·šaḏ·mō·wṯ qiḏ·rō·wn wə·nā·śā ’eṯ- ‘ă·p̄ā·rām bêṯ- ’êl
verses.literal: Then the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest the priests second in rank and the doorkeepers . . . to remove from the temple of the LORD all the articles made for Baal Asherah and all the host of heaven And he burned them outside Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron and carried their ashes to Bethel
verses.literalPt: E o rei mandou ao sumo sacerdote Hilquias, aos sacerdotes da segunda ordem, e aos guardas do umbral da porta, que tirassem do templo do SENHOR todos os vasos que se tinham feito para Baal, para o bosque e para todo o exército dos céus e os queimou fora de Jerusalém, nos campos de Cedrom e levou as cinzas deles a Betel.

verses.original: וְהִשְׁבִּ֣ית אֶת־ הַכְּמָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָֽתְנוּ֙ מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיְקַטֵּ֤ר בַּבָּמוֹת֙ בְּעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וּמְסִבֵּ֖י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְאֶת־ הַֽמְקַטְּרִ֣ים לַבַּ֗עַל לַשֶּׁ֤מֶשׁ וְלַיָּרֵ֙חַ֙ וְלַמַּזָּל֔וֹת וּלְכֹ֖ל צְבָ֥א הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiš·bîṯ ’eṯ- hak·kə·mā·rîm ’ă·šer nā·ṯə·nū mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh way·qaṭ·ṭêr bab·bā·mō·wṯ bə·‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh ū·mə·sib·bê yə·rū·šā·lim wə·’eṯ- ham·qaṭ·ṭə·rîm lab·ba·‘al laš·še·meš wə·lay·yā·rê·aḥ wə·lam·maz·zā·lō·wṯ ū·lə·ḵōl ṣə·ḇā haš·šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: Josiah also did away with the idolatrous priests ordained by the kings of Judah to burn incense on the high places of the cities of Judah and in the places all around Jerusalem those who had burned incense to Baal to the sun and moon to the constellations and to all the host of heaven
verses.literalPt: Também destituiu os sacerdotes que os reis de Judá estabeleceram para incensarem sobre os altos nas cidades de Judá e ao redor de Jerusalém, como também os que queimavam incenso a Baal, ao sol, à lua, e aos planetas, e a todo o exército dos céus.

verses.original: וַיֹּצֵ֣א אֶת־ הָאֲשֵׁרָה֩ מִבֵּ֨ית יְהוָ֜ה מִח֤וּץ לִירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ אֶל־ נַ֣חַל קִדְר֔וֹן וַיִּשְׂרֹ֥ף אֹתָ֛הּ בְּנַ֥חַל קִדְר֖וֹן וַיָּ֣דֶק לְעָפָ֑ר וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ֙ אֶת־ עֲפָרָ֔הּ עַל־ קֶ֖בֶר בְּנֵ֥י הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·ṣê ’eṯ- hā·’ă·šê·rāh mib·bêṯ Yah·weh mi·ḥūṣ lî·rū·šā·lim ’el- na·ḥal qiḏ·rō·wn way·yiś·rōp̄ ’ō·ṯāh bə·na·ḥal qiḏ·rō·wn way·yā·ḏeq lə·‘ā·p̄ār way·yaš·lêḵ ’eṯ- ‘ă·p̄ā·rāh ‘al- qe·ḇer bə·nê hā·‘ām
verses.literal: He brought the Asherah pole from the house of the LORD to the Kidron Valley outside Jerusalem and there . . . he burned it ground it to powder and threw its dust on the graves of the common people
verses.literalPt: Também tirou da casa do SENHOR o ídolo do bosque levando-o para fora de Jerusalém até ao ribeiro de Cedrom, e o queimou junto ao ribeiro de Cedrom, e o desfez em pó, e lançou o seu pó sobre as sepulturas dos filhos do povo.

verses.original: וַיִּתֹּץ֙ אֶת־ בָּתֵּ֣י הַקְּדֵשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הַנָּשִׁ֗ים אֹרְג֥וֹת שָׁ֛ם בָּתִּ֖ים לָאֲשֵׁרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tōṣ ’eṯ- bāt·tê haq·qə·ḏê·šîm ’ă·šer bə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh ’ă·šer han·nā·šîm ’ō·rə·ḡō·wṯ šām bāt·tîm lā·’ă·šê·rāh
verses.literal: He also tore down the quarters of the male shrine prostitutes that were in the house of the LORD where the women had woven . . . tapestries for Asherah
verses.literalPt: Também derrubou as casas dos sodomitas que estavam na casa do SENHOR, em que as mulheres teciam casinhas para o ídolo do bosque.

verses.original: וַיָּבֵ֤א אֶת־ כָּל־ הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ מֵעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיְטַמֵּ֣א אֶת־ הַבָּמ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֤ר קִטְּרוּ־ שָׁ֙מָּה֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים מִגֶּ֖בַע עַד־ בְּאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע וְנָתַ֞ץ אֶת־ בָּמ֣וֹת הַשְּׁעָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר־ פֶּ֜תַח שַׁ֤עַר יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ שַׂר־ הָעִ֔יר אֲשֶֽׁר־ עַל־ שְׂמֹ֥אול אִ֖ישׁ בְּשַׁ֥עַר הָעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇê ’eṯ- kāl- hak·kō·hă·nîm mê·‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh way·ṭam·mê ’eṯ- hab·bā·mō·wṯ ’ă·šer qiṭ·ṭə·rū- šām·māh hak·kō·hă·nîm mig·ge·ḇa‘ ‘aḏ- bə·’êr šā·ḇa‘ wə·nā·ṯaṣ ’eṯ- bā·mō·wṯ haš·šə·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer- pe·ṯaḥ ša·‘ar yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ śar- hā·‘îr ’ă·šer- ‘al- śə·mō·wl ’îš bə·ša·‘ar hā·‘îr
verses.literal: Then Josiah brought all the priests from the cities of Judah and desecrated the high places from Geba to Beersheba where the priests had burned incense He tore down the high places of the gates at the entrance of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city which was to the left . . . of the city gate
verses.literalPt: E a todos os sacerdotes trouxe das cidades de Judá, e profanou os altos em que os sacerdotes queimavam incenso, desde Geba até Berseba; e derrubou os altos que estavam às portas, junto à entrada da porta de Josué, o governador da cidade, que estava à esquerda daquele que entrava pela porta da cidade.

verses.original: אַ֗ךְ לֹ֤א יַֽעֲלוּ֙ כֹּהֲנֵ֣י הַבָּמ֔וֹת אֶל־ מִזְבַּ֥ח יְהוָ֖ה בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּ֛י אִם־ אָכְל֥וּ מַצּ֖וֹת בְּת֥וֹךְ אֲחֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ lō ya·‘ă·lū kō·hă·nê hab·bā·mō·wṯ ’el- miz·baḥ Yah·weh bî·rū·šā·lim kî ’im- ’ā·ḵə·lū maṣ·ṣō·wṯ bə·ṯō·wḵ ’ă·ḥê·hem
verses.literal: Although the priests of the high places did not come up to the altar of the LORD in Jerusalem - they ate unleavened bread with their fellow priests
verses.literalPt: Mas os sacerdotes dos altos não sacrificavam sobre o altar do SENHOR em Jerusalém; porém comiam pães ázimos no meio de seus irmãos.

verses.original: וְטִמֵּ֣א אֶת־ הַתֹּ֔פֶת אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּגֵ֣י בְנֵי הִנֹּ֑ם לְבִלְתִּ֗י לְהַעֲבִ֨יר אִ֜ישׁ אֶת־ בְּנ֧וֹ וְאֶת־ בִּתּ֛וֹ בָּאֵ֖שׁ לַמֹּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṭim·mê ’eṯ- hat·tō·p̄eṯ ’ă·šer bə·ḡê ḇə·nē hin·nōm lə·ḇil·tî lə·ha·‘ă·ḇîr ’îš ’eṯ- bə·nōw wə·’eṯ- bit·tōw bā·’êš lam·mō·leḵ
verses.literal: He also desecrated Topheth in the Valley of Ben-hinnom so that no one could sacrifice his son or daughter in the fire to Molech
verses.literalPt: Também profanou a Tofete, que está no vale dos filhos de Hinom, para que ninguém fizesse passar a seu filho, ou sua filha, pelo fogo a Moloque.

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁבֵּ֣ת אֶת־ הַסּוּסִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתְנוּ֩ מַלְכֵ֨י יְהוּדָ֤ה לַשֶּׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ מִבֹּ֣א בֵית־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ לִשְׁכַּת֙ נְתַן־ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַסָּרִ֔יס אֲשֶׁ֖ר בַּפַּרְוָרִ֑ים וְאֶת־ מַרְכְּב֥וֹת הַשֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ שָׂרַ֥ף בָּאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·bêṯ ’eṯ- has·sū·sîm ’ă·šer nā·ṯə·nū mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh laš·še·meš mib·bō ḇêṯ- Yah·weh ’el- liš·kaṯ nə·ṯan- me·leḵ has·sā·rîs ’ă·šer bap·par·wā·rîm wə·’eṯ- mar·kə·ḇō·wṯ haš·še·meš śā·rap̄ bā·’êš
verses.literal: And he removed from the entrance to the house of the LORD the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun They were in the court near the chamber of an official named Nathan-melech And Josiah burned up . . . the chariots of the sun
verses.literalPt: Também tirou os cavalos que os reis de Judá tinham dedicado ao sol, à entrada da casa do SENHOR, perto da câmara de Natã-Meleque, o camareiro, que estava no recinto; e os carros do sol queimou a fogo.

verses.original: וְאֶֽת־ הַֽמִּזְבְּח֡וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ הַגָּג֩ עֲלִיַּ֨ת אָחָ֜ז אֲשֶׁר־ עָשׂ֣וּ׀ מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה וְאֶת־ הַֽמִּזְבְּחוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה בִּשְׁתֵּ֛י חַצְר֥וֹת בֵּית־ יְהוָ֖ה נָתַ֣ץ הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיָּ֣רָץ מִשָּׁ֔ם וְהִשְׁלִ֥יךְ אֶת־ עֲפָרָ֖ם אֶל־ נַ֥חַל קִדְרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ham·miz·bə·ḥō·wṯ ’ă·šer ‘al- hag·gāḡ ‘ă·lî·yaṯ ’ā·ḥāz ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śū mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh wə·’eṯ- ham·miz·bə·ḥō·wṯ ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh mə·naš·šeh biš·tê ḥaṣ·rō·wṯ bêṯ- Yah·weh nā·ṯaṣ ham·me·leḵ way·yā·rāṣ miš·šām wə·hiš·lîḵ ’eṯ- ‘ă·p̄ā·rām ’el- na·ḥal qiḏ·rō·wn
verses.literal: He pulled down the altars that the kings of Judah had set up on the roof near the upper chamber of Ahaz and the altars that Manasseh had set up in the two courtyards of the house of the LORD The king pulverized them there and threw their dust into the Kidron Valley
verses.literalPt: Também o rei derrubou os altares que estavam sobre o terraço do cenáculo de Acaz, os quais os reis de Judá tinham feito, como também o rei derrubou os altares que fizera Manassés nos dois átrios da casa do SENHOR; e esmiuçados os tirou dali e lançou o pó deles no ribeiro de Cedrom.

verses.original: וְֽאֶת־ הַבָּמ֞וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם אֲשֶׁר֮ מִימִ֣ין לְהַר־ הַמַּשְׁחִית֒ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּ֠נָה שְׁלֹמֹ֨ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל לְעַשְׁתֹּ֣רֶת׀ שִׁקֻּ֣ץ צִידֹנִ֗ים וְלִכְמוֹשׁ֙ שִׁקֻּ֣ץ מוֹאָ֔ב וּלְמִלְכֹּ֖ם תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־ עַמּ֑וֹן טִמֵּ֖א הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- hab·bā·mō·wṯ ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê yə·rū·šā·lim ’ă·šer mî·mîn lə·har- ham·maš·ḥîṯ ’ă·šer bā·nāh šə·lō·mōh me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl lə·‘aš·tō·reṯ šiq·quṣ ṣî·ḏō·nîm wə·liḵ·mō·wōš šiq·quṣ mō·w·’āḇ ū·lə·mil·kōm tō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ bə·nê- ‘am·mō·wn ṭim·mê ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: The king also desecrated the high places east of Jerusalem to the south of the Mount of Corruption which King Solomon of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites and for Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites . . .
verses.literalPt: O rei profanou também os altos que estavam defronte de Jerusalém, à mão direita do monte de Masite, os quais edificara Salomão, rei de Israel, a Astarote, a abominação dos sidônios, e a Quemós, a abominação dos moabitas, e a Milcom, a abominação dos filhos de Amom.

verses.original: וְשִׁבַּר֙ אֶת־ הַמַּצֵּב֔וֹת וַיִּכְרֹ֖ת אֶת־ הָאֲשֵׁרִ֑ים וַיְמַלֵּ֥א אֶת־ מְקוֹמָ֖ם עַצְמ֥וֹת אָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šib·bar ’eṯ- ham·maṣ·ṣê·ḇō·wṯ way·yiḵ·rōṯ ’eṯ- hā·’ă·šê·rîm way·mal·lê ’eṯ- mə·qō·w·mām ‘aṣ·mō·wṯ ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: He smashed the sacred pillars to pieces cut down the Asherah poles and covered the sites with human bones
verses.literalPt: Semelhantemente quebrou as estátuas, cortou os bosques e encheu o seu lugar com ossos de homens.

verses.original: וְגַ֨ם אֶת־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֜חַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּבֵֽית־ אֵ֗ל הַבָּמָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה יָרָבְעָ֤ם בֶּן־ נְבָט֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶחֱטִ֣יא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל גַּ֣ם אֶת־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֧חַ הַה֛וּא וְאֶת־ הַבָּמָ֖ה נָתָ֑ץ וַיִּשְׂרֹ֧ף אֶת־ הַבָּמָ֛ה הֵדַ֥ק לְעָפָ֖ר וְשָׂרַ֥ף אֲשֵׁרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam ’eṯ- ham·miz·bê·aḥ ’ă·šer bə·ḇêṯ- ’êl hab·bā·māh ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ben- nə·ḇāṭ ’ă·šer he·ḥĕ·ṭî ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl gam ’eṯ- ham·miz·bê·aḥ ha·hū wə·’eṯ- hab·bā·māh nā·ṯāṣ way·yiś·rōp̄ ’eṯ- hab·bā·māh hê·ḏaq lə·‘ā·p̄ār wə·śā·rap̄ ’ă·šê·rāh
verses.literal: He even pulled down the altar at Bethel the high place set up by Jeroboam son of Nebat who had caused Israel to sin - - Then he burned the high place ground it to powder and burned the Asherah pole
verses.literalPt: E também o altar que estava em Betel, e o alto que fez Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, com que tinha feito Israel pecar, esse altar derrubou juntamente com o alto; queimando o alto, em pó o esmiuçou, e queimou o ídolo do bosque.

verses.original: וַיִּ֣פֶן יֹאשִׁיָּ֗הוּ וַיַּ֨רְא אֶת־ הַקְּבָרִ֤ים אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁם֙ בָּהָ֔ר וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח וַיִּקַּ֤ח אֶת־ הָֽעֲצָמוֹת֙ מִן־ הַקְּבָרִ֔ים וַיִּשְׂרֹ֥ף עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ וַֽיְטַמְּאֵ֑הוּ כִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר קָרָא֙ אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר קָרָ֔א אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·p̄en yō·šî·yā·hū way·yar ’eṯ- haq·qə·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer- šām bā·hār way·yiš·laḥ way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- hā·‘ă·ṣā·mō·wṯ min- haq·qə·ḇā·rîm way·yiś·rōp̄ ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ way·ṭam·mə·’ê·hū kiḏ·ḇar Yah·weh ’ă·šer qā·rā ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer qā·rā ’eṯ- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh
verses.literal: And as Josiah turned he saw the tombs there on the hillside and he sent someone to take the bones out of the tombs and he burned them on the altar to defile it according to the word of the LORD proclaimed by the man of God who had foretold these things
verses.literalPt: E, virando-se Josias, viu as sepulturas que estavam ali no monte; e mandou tirar os ossos das sepulturas, e os queimou sobre aquele altar, e assim o profanou, conforme a palavra do SENHOR, que profetizara o homem de Deus, quando anunciou estas palavras.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מָ֚ה הַצִּיּ֣וּן הַלָּ֔ז אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֲנִ֣י רֹאֶ֑ה וַיֹּאמְר֨וּ אֵלָ֜יו אַנְשֵׁ֣י הָעִ֗יר הַקֶּ֤בֶר אִישׁ־ הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֣א מִֽיהוּדָ֔ה וַיִּקְרָ֗א אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֤ים הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתָ עַ֖ל הַמִּזְבַּ֥ח בֵּֽית־ אֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer māh haṣ·ṣî·yūn hal·lāz ’ă·šer ’ă·nî rō·’eh way·yō·mə·rū ’ê·lāw ’an·šê hā·‘îr haq·qe·ḇer ’îš- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer- bā mî·hū·ḏāh way·yiq·rā ’eṯ- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh ’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯā ‘al ham·miz·baḥ bêṯ- ’êl
verses.literal: Then the king asked What is this monument I see And the men of the city replied . . . It is the tomb of the man of God who came from Judah and proclaimed these things that you have done to the altar of Bethel
verses.literalPt: Então disse: Que é este monumento que vejo? E os homens da cidade lhe disseram: É a sepultura do homem de Deus que veio de Judá, e anunciou estas coisas que fizeste contra este altar de Betel.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ הַנִּ֣יחוּ ל֔וֹ אִ֖ישׁ אַל־ יָנַ֣ע עַצְמֹתָ֑יו וַֽיְמַלְּטוּ֙ עַצְמֹתָ֔יו אֵ֚ת עַצְמ֣וֹת הַנָּבִ֔יא אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֖א מִשֹּׁמְרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer han·nî·ḥū lōw ’îš ’al- yā·na‘ ‘aṣ·mō·ṯāw way·mal·lə·ṭū ‘aṣ·mō·ṯāw ’êṯ ‘aṣ·mō·wṯ han·nā·ḇî ’ă·šer- bā miš·šō·mə·rō·wn
verses.literal: Let him rest said Josiah Do not let anyone disturb his bones So they left his bones undisturbed along with those of the prophet who had come from Samaria
verses.literalPt: E disse: Deixai-o estar; ninguém mexa nos seus ossos. Assim deixaram estar os seus ossos com os ossos do profeta que viera de Samaria.

verses.original: וְגַם֩ אֶת־ כָּל־ בָּתֵּ֨י הַבָּמ֜וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ בְּעָרֵ֣י שֹׁמְר֗וֹן אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשׂ֜וּ מַלְכֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְהַכְעִ֔יס הֵסִ֖יר יֹֽאשִׁיָּ֑הוּ וַיַּ֣עַשׂ לָהֶ֔ם כְּכָל־ הַֽמַּעֲשִׂ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה בְּבֵֽית־ אֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam ’eṯ- kāl- bāt·tê hab·bā·mō·wṯ ’ă·šer bə·‘ā·rê šō·mə·rō·wn ’ă·šer ‘ā·śū mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl lə·haḵ·‘îs hê·sîr yō·šî·yā·hū way·ya·‘aś lā·hem kə·ḵāl- ham·ma·‘ă·śîm ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh bə·ḇêṯ- ’êl
verses.literal: Just as Josiah . . . . . . . . . had done at Bethel so also - in the cities of Samaria he removed all the shrines of the high places set up by the kings of Israel who had provoked the LORD to anger
verses.literalPt: Demais disto também Josias tirou todas as casas dos altos que havia nas cidades de Samaria, e que os reis de Israel tinham feito para provocarem à ira o SENHOR; e lhes fez conforme todos os atos que tinha feito em Betel.

verses.original: וַ֠יִּזְבַּח אֶת־ כָּל־ כֹּהֲנֵ֨י הַבָּמ֤וֹת אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁם֙ עַל־ הַֽמִּזְבְּח֔וֹת וַיִּשְׂרֹ֛ף אֶת־ עַצְמ֥וֹת אָדָ֖ם עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וַיָּ֖שָׁב יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiz·baḥ ’eṯ- kāl- kō·hă·nê hab·bā·mō·wṯ ’ă·šer- šām ‘al- ham·miz·bə·ḥō·wṯ way·yiś·rōp̄ ’eṯ- ‘aṣ·mō·wṯ ’ā·ḏām ‘ă·lê·hem way·yā·šāḇ yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: On the altars he slaughtered all the priests of the high places - and he burned human bones on them Then he returned to Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: E sacrificou todos os sacerdotes dos altos, que havia ali, sobre os altares, e queimou ossos humanos sobre eles; depois voltou a Jerusalém.

verses.original: וַיְצַ֤ו הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָעָ֣ם לֵאמֹ֔ר עֲשׂ֣וּ פֶ֔סַח לַֽיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֑ם כַּכָּת֕וּב עַ֛ל סֵ֥פֶר הַבְּרִ֖ית הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw ham·me·leḵ ’eṯ- kāl- hā·‘ām lê·mōr ‘ă·śū p̄e·saḥ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem kak·kā·ṯūḇ ‘al sê·p̄er hab·bə·rîṯ haz·zeh
verses.literal: The king commanded all the people . . . Keep the Passover of the LORD your God as it is written in this Book of the Covenant
verses.literalPt: O rei deu ordem a todo o povo, dizendo: Celebrai a páscoa ao SENHOR vosso Deus, como está escrito no livro da aliança.

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א נַֽעֲשָׂה֙ כַּפֶּ֣סַח הַזֶּ֔ה מִימֵי֙ הַשֹּׁ֣פְטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁפְט֖וּ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְכֹ֗ל יְמֵ֛י מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וּמַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō na·‘ă·śāh kap·pe·saḥ haz·zeh mî·mê haš·šō·p̄ə·ṭîm ’ă·šer šā·p̄ə·ṭū ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl wə·ḵōl yə·mê mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl ū·mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: No such Passover had been observed from the days of the judges who had governed Israel through all the days of the kings of Israel . . . and Judah
verses.literalPt: Porque nunca se celebrou tal páscoa como esta desde os dias dos juízes que julgaram a Israel, nem em todos os dias dos reis de Israel, nem tampouco dos reis de Judá.

verses.original: כִּ֗י אִם־ בִּשְׁמֹנֶ֤ה עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לַמֶּ֖לֶךְ יֹֽאשִׁיָּ֑הוּ נַעֲשָׂ֞ה הַפֶּ֧סַח הַזֶּ֛ה לַיהוָ֖ה בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- biš·mō·neh ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh lam·me·leḵ yō·šî·yā·hū na·‘ă·śāh hap·pe·saḥ haz·zeh Yah·weh bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: But . . . in the eighteenth . . . year of Josiah’s reign this Passover was observed to the LORD in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Porém no ano décimo oitavo do rei Josias esta páscoa se celebrou ao SENHOR em Jerusalém.

verses.original: וְגַ֣ם אֶת־ הָאֹב֣וֹת וְאֶת־ הַ֠יִּדְּעֹנִים וְאֶת־ הַתְּרָפִ֨ים וְאֶת־ הַגִּלֻּלִ֜ים וְאֵ֣ת כָּל־ הַשִּׁקֻּצִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִרְאוּ֙ בְּאֶ֤רֶץ יְהוּדָה֙ וּבִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם בִּעֵ֖ר יֹֽאשִׁיָּ֑הוּ לְ֠מַעַן הָקִ֞ים אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֤י הַתּוֹרָה֙ הַכְּתֻבִ֣ים עַל־ הַסֵּ֔פֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָצָ֛א חִלְקִיָּ֥הוּ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam ’eṯ- hā·’ō·ḇō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- hay·yid·də·‘ō·nîm wə·’eṯ- hat·tə·rā·p̄îm wə·’eṯ- hag·gil·lu·lîm wə·’êṯ kāl- haš·šiq·qu·ṣîm ’ă·šer nir·’ū bə·’e·reṣ yə·hū·ḏāh ū·ḇî·rū·šā·lim bi·‘êr yō·šî·yā·hū lə·ma·‘an hā·qîm ’eṯ- diḇ·rê hat·tō·w·rāh hak·kə·ṯu·ḇîm ‘al- has·sê·p̄er ’ă·šer mā·ṣā ḥil·qî·yā·hū hak·kō·hên bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Furthermore Josiah removed the mediums and spiritists the household gods and idols and all the abominations that were seen in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem He did this to carry out the words of the law written in the book that Hilkiah the priest had found in the house of the LORD
verses.literalPt: E também os adivinhos, os feiticeiros, os terafins, os ídolos, e todas as abominações que se viam na terra de Judá e em Jerusalém, os extirpou Josias, para confirmar as palavras da lei, que estavam escritas no livro que o sacerdote Hilquias achara na casa do SENHOR.

verses.original: וְכָמֹהוּ֩ לֹֽא־ הָיָ֨ה לְפָנָ֜יו מֶ֗לֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁ֤ב אֶל־ יְהוָה֙ בְּכָל־ לְבָב֤וֹ וּבְכָל־ נַפְשׁוֹ֙ וּבְכָל־ מְאֹד֔וֹ כְּכֹ֖ל תּוֹרַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֑ה וְאַחֲרָ֖יו לֹֽא־ קָ֥ם כָּמֹֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵā·mō·hū lō- hā·yāh lə·p̄ā·nāw me·leḵ ’ă·šer- šāḇ ’el- Yah·weh bə·ḵāl lə·ḇā·ḇōw ū·ḇə·ḵāl nap̄·šōw ū·ḇə·ḵāl mə·’ō·ḏōw kə·ḵōl tō·w·raṯ mō·šeh wə·’a·ḥă·rāw lō- qām kā·mō·hū
verses.literal: Neither before nor after Josiah was there any king like him who turned to the LORD with all his heart and with all his soul and with all his strength according to all the Law of Moses
verses.literalPt: E antes dele não houve rei semelhante, que se convertesse ao SENHOR com todo o seu coração, com toda a sua alma e com todas as suas forças, conforme toda a lei de Moisés; e depois dele nunca se levantou outro tal.

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ׀ לֹֽא־ שָׁ֣ב יְהוָ֗ה מֵחֲר֤וֹן אַפּוֹ֙ הַגָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁר־ חָרָ֥ה אַפּ֖וֹ בִּֽיהוּדָ֑ה עַ֚ל כָּל־ הַכְּעָסִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִכְעִיס֖וֹ מְנַשֶּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ lō- šāḇ Yah·weh mê·ḥă·rō·wn ’ap·pōw hag·gā·ḏō·wl ’ă·šer- ḥā·rāh ’ap·pōw bî·hū·ḏāh ‘al kāl- hak·kə·‘ā·sîm ’ă·šer hiḵ·‘î·sōw mə·naš·šeh
verses.literal: Nevertheless the LORD did not turn away from the fury of His burning anger which was kindled . . . against Judah because of all that Manasseh had done to provoke Him to anger
verses.literalPt: Todavia o SENHOR não se demoveu do ardor da sua grande ira, com que ardia contra Judá, por todas as provocações com que Manassés o tinha provocado.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֗ה גַּ֤ם אֶת־ יְהוּדָה֙ אָסִיר֙ מֵעַ֣ל פָּנַ֔י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הֲסִרֹ֖תִי אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּ֠מָאַסְתִּי אֶת־ הָעִ֨יר הַזֹּ֤את אֲשֶׁר־ בָּחַ֙רְתִּי֙ אֶת־ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְאֶת־ הַבַּ֔יִת אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֔רְתִּי יִהְיֶ֥ה שְׁמִ֖י שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh gam ’eṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh ’ā·sîr mê·‘al pā·nay ka·’ă·šer hă·si·rō·ṯî ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl ū·mā·’as·tî ’eṯ- hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ ’ă·šer- bā·ḥar·tî ’eṯ- yə·rū·šā·lim wə·’eṯ- hab·ba·yiṯ ’ă·šer ’ā·mar·tî yih·yeh šə·mî šām
verses.literal: For the LORD had said I will remove Judah from My sight just as I removed Israel I will reject this city Jerusalem which I chose and the temple of which I said My Name shall be there
verses.literalPt: E disse o SENHOR: Também a Judá hei de tirar de diante da minha face, como tirei a Israel, e rejeitarei esta cidade de Jerusalém que escolhi, como também a casa de que disse: Estará ali o meu nome.

verses.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יֹאשִׁיָּ֖הוּ וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲלֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer diḇ·rê yō·šî·yā·hū wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh hă·lō- hêm kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er diḇ·rê hay·yā·mîm lə·mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: As for the rest of the acts of Josiah and all his accomplishments . . . are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles . . . of the Kings of Judah
verses.literalPt: Ora, o mais dos atos de Josias e tudo quanto fez, porventura não está escrito no livro das crônicas dos reis de Judá?

verses.original: בְּיָמָ֡יו עָלָה֩ פַרְעֹ֨ה נְכֹ֧ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרַ֛יִם עַל־ מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּׁ֖וּר עַל־ נְהַר־ פְּרָ֑ת וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ יֹאשִׁיָּ֙הוּ֙ לִקְרָאת֔וֹ וַיְמִיתֵ֙הוּ֙ בִּמְגִדּ֔וֹ כִּרְאֹת֖וֹ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·yā·māw ‘ā·lāh p̄ar·‘ōh nə·ḵōh me·leḵ- miṣ·ra·yim ‘al- me·leḵ ’aš·šūr ‘al- nə·har- pə·rāṯ way·yê·leḵ ham·me·leḵ yō·šî·yā·hū liq·rā·ṯōw way·mî·ṯê·hū bim·ḡid·dōw kir·’ō·ṯōw ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: During Josiah’s reign Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt marched up to help the king of Assyria at the Euphrates River King Josiah went out to confront him but Neco faced him and killed him at Megiddo
verses.literalPt: Nos seus dias subiu Faraó Neco, rei do Egito, contra o rei da Assíria, ao rio Eufrates; e o rei Josias lhe foi ao encontro; e, vendo-o ele, o matou em Megido.

verses.original: וַיַּרְכִּבֻ֨הוּ עֲבָדָ֥יו מֵת֙ מִמְּגִדּ֔וֹ וַיְבִאֻ֙הוּ֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַֽיִּקְבְּרֻ֖הוּ בִּקְבֻֽרָת֑וֹ וַיִּקַּ֣ח עַם־ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֶת־ יְהֽוֹאָחָז֙ בֶּן־ יֹ֣אשִׁיָּ֔הוּ וַיִּמְשְׁח֥וּ אֹת֛וֹ וַיַּמְלִ֥יכוּ אֹת֖וֹ תַּ֥חַת אָבִֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yar·ki·ḇu·hū ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw mêṯ mim·mə·ḡid·dōw way·ḇi·’u·hū yə·rū·šā·lim way·yiq·bə·ru·hū biq·ḇu·rā·ṯōw way·yiq·qaḥ ‘am- hā·’ā·reṣ ’eṯ- yə·hō·w·’ā·ḥāz ben- yō·šî·yā·hū way·yim·šə·ḥū ’ō·ṯōw way·yam·lî·ḵū ’ō·ṯōw ta·ḥaṯ ’ā·ḇîw
verses.literal: From Megiddo his servants carried his body in a chariot brought him to Jerusalem and buried him in his own tomb Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz son of Josiah anointed him and made him king in place of his father
verses.literalPt: E seus servos, num carro, o levaram morto, de Megido, e o trouxeram a Jerusalém, e o sepultaram na sua sepultura; e o povo da terra tomou a Joacaz, filho de Josias, e ungiram-no, e fizeram-no rei em lugar de seu pai.

verses.original: בֶּן־ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְשָׁלֹ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ יְהוֹאָחָ֣ז בְּמָלְכ֔וֹ וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ חֲמוּטַ֥ל בַּֽת־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ מִלִּבְנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ‘eś·rîm wə·šā·lōš šā·nāh yə·hō·w·’ā·ḥāz bə·mā·lə·ḵōw ū·šə·lō·šāh ḥo·ḏā·šîm mā·laḵ bî·rū·šā·lim wə·šêm ’im·mōw ḥă·mū·ṭal baṯ- yir·mə·yā·hū mil·liḇ·nāh
verses.literal: Jehoahaz was twenty-three . . . years old . . . when he became king and he reigned in Jerusalem three months His mother’s name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah she was from Libnah
verses.literalPt: Tinha Joacaz vinte e três anos de idade quando começou a reinar, e três meses reinou em Jerusalém; e era o nome de sua mãe Hamutal, filha de Jeremias, de Libna.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ עָשׂ֖וּ אֲבֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śū ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw
verses.literal: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD just as his fathers had done
verses.literalPt: E fez o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR, conforme tudo o que fizeram seus pais.

verses.original: וַיַּאַסְרֵהוּ֩ פַרְעֹ֨ה נְכֹ֤ה בְרִבְלָה֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חֲמָ֔ת בִּמְלֹךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַיִּתֶּן־ עֹ֙נֶשׁ֙ עַל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ מֵאָ֥ה כִכַּר־ כֶּ֖סֶף וְכִכַּ֥ר זָהָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·’as·rê·hū p̄ar·‘ōh nə·ḵōh ḇə·riḇ·lāh bə·’e·reṣ ḥă·māṯ bim·lōḵ bî·rū·šā·lim way·yit·ten- ‘ō·neš ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ mê·’āh ḵik·kar- ke·sep̄ wə·ḵik·kar zā·hāḇ
verses.literal: And Pharaoh Neco imprisoned Jehoahaz at Riblah in the land of Hamath so that he could not reign in Jerusalem and he imposed on Judah a levy of a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold
verses.literalPt: Porém Faraó Neco o mandou prender em Ribla, em terra de Hamate, para que não reinasse em Jerusalém; e à terra impôs pena de cem talentos de prata e um talento de ouro.

verses.original: וַיַּמְלֵךְ֩ פַּרְעֹ֨ה נְכֹ֜ה אֶת־ אֶלְיָקִ֣ים בֶּן־ יֹאשִׁיָּ֗הוּ תַּ֚חַת יֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ אָבִ֔יו וַיַּסֵּ֥ב אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ יְהוֹיָקִ֑ים וְאֶת־ יְהוֹאָחָ֣ז לָקָ֔ח וַיָּבֹ֥א מִצְרַ֖יִם וַיָּ֥מָת שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yam·lêḵ par·‘ōh nə·ḵōh ’eṯ- ’el·yā·qîm ben- yō·šî·yā·hū ta·ḥaṯ yō·šî·yā·hū ’ā·ḇîw way·yas·sêḇ ’eṯ- šə·mōw yə·hō·w·yā·qîm wə·’eṯ- yə·hō·w·’ā·ḥāz lā·qāḥ way·yā·ḇō miṣ·ra·yim way·yā·māṯ šām
verses.literal: Then Pharaoh Neco made Eliakim son of Josiah king in place of his father Josiah and he changed Eliakim’s name to Jehoiakim But Neco took Jehoahaz and carried him off to Egypt where he died . . .
verses.literalPt: Também Faraó Neco constituiu rei a Eliaquim, filho de Josias, em lugar de seu pai Josias, e lhe mudou o nome para Jeoiaquim; porém a Joacaz tomou consigo, e foi ao Egito, e morreu ali.

verses.original: וְהַכֶּ֣סֶף וְהַזָּהָ֗ב נָתַ֤ן יְהוֹיָקִים֙ לְפַרְעֹ֔ה אַ֚ךְ הֶעֱרִ֣יךְ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ לָתֵ֥ת אֶת־ הַכֶּ֖סֶף עַל־ פִּ֣י פַרְעֹ֑ה אִ֣ישׁ כְּעֶרְכּ֗וֹ נָגַ֞שׂ אֶת־ הַכֶּ֤סֶף וְאֶת־ הַזָּהָב֙ אֶת־ עַ֣ם הָאָ֔רֶץ לָתֵ֖ת לְפַרְעֹ֥ה נְכֹֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hak·ke·sep̄ wə·haz·zā·hāḇ nā·ṯan yə·hō·w·yā·qîm lə·p̄ar·‘ōh ’aḵ he·‘ĕ·rîḵ ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ lā·ṯêṯ ’eṯ- hak·ke·sep̄ ‘al- pî p̄ar·‘ōh ’îš kə·‘er·kōw nā·ḡaś ’eṯ- hak·ke·sep̄ wə·’eṯ- haz·zā·hāḇ ’eṯ- ‘am hā·’ā·reṣ lā·ṯêṯ lə·p̄ar·‘ōh nə·ḵōh
verses.literal: So Jehoiakim paid the silver and gold to Pharaoh Neco but to meet Pharaoh’s demand he taxed the land - and exacted the silver and the gold from the people . . . each according to his wealth -
verses.literalPt: E Jeoiaquim deu aquela prata e aquele ouro a Faraó; porém tributou a terra, para dar esse dinheiro conforme o mandado de Faraó; a cada um segundo a sua avaliação exigiu a prata e o ouro do povo da terra, para o dar a Faraó Neco.

verses.original: בֶּן־ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְחָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָ֨ה יְהוֹיָקִ֣ים בְּמָלְכ֔וֹ וְאַחַ֤ת עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ זְבִידָה בַת־ פְּדָיָ֖ה מִן־ רוּמָֽה׃

verses.literal: Jehoiakim was twenty-five . . . years old . . . when he became king and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven . . . years His mother’s name was Zebidah daughter of Pedaiah she was from Rumah
verses.literalPt: Tinha Jeoiaquim vinte e cinco anos de idade quando começou a reinar, e reinou onze anos em Jerusalém; e era o nome de sua mãe Zebida, filha de Pedaías, de Ruma.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ עָשׂ֖וּ אֲבֹתָֽיו׃
